, Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly identified the Census “County Population Totals: 2020–2024” page (county-level estimates) as the relevant source for county seat populations. This conflated counties with county seats (cities/towns) and pointed to estimates rather than 2020 decennial place-level data on data.census.gov, misdirecting the workflow and preventing correct retrieval and calculation.
